Hi, I’m Anish, a software engineer in Dublin who builds and runs the systems behind real-money products, and who likes knowing why the code matters to the business.

For nearly three years I worked on DraftKings’ iGaming casino and sportsbook platforms through TestingXperts, across 7 regulated US and Canadian markets. I owned the game release pipeline for DraftKings Casino and Golden Nugget as the sole technical contact for 20+ game vendors, scaled it from around 150 to 500+ games per sprint with Python automation, and built .NET/C# and MySQL backend services behind game launch, lobby and promotions. That work earned a written commendation from DraftKings engineering leadership for the Golden Nugget launch, and two promotions in my first 12 months.

Today I build production voice AI for an HR-tech company: an AI recruiter that phones and screens job candidates in real time. I shipped failure alerting across 9 AI providers so outages are caught before candidates notice, and redesigned the partner platform’s dashboard in React and TypeScript.

I also hold a First Class M.Sc. in Data Analytics. The projects below come from that degree and my own experiments, and my newer backend engineering projects will be added here soon.

I’m looking for backend, integration and production engineering roles in Dublin. Feel free to get in touch or view my CV.

## Featured Projects

* **Customer Churn Prediction (Final M.Sc. Project):** An interactive Streamlit application using **Explainable AI (SHAP)** to identify causal drivers of churn in Telecom and Insurance sectors. [View Project](./projects/churn-prediction/churn_index.qmd)

* **FIFA Player Analytics (Data Viz):** A comprehensive **Tableau & Power BI** dashboard suite analyzing global player statistics to identify high-value talent. [View Dashboard](./projects/data-viz/football-recruitment/football_index.qmd)

* **Tekken 8 Interactive Roster (UI/UX App Design):** An immersive game roster selector built by scraping web-portal data via **Python**, pushed beyond corporate BI templates into a high-fidelity gaming interface inside **Tableau**. [View Dashboard](./projects/tekken/tekken-dash.qmd)

* **NYC Taxi Operational Intelligence (Data Storage):** A full-scale **Data Warehouse** proof-of-concept using a Star Schema, SQL Server, and Neo4j to derive business intelligence from complex urban transport data. [View Case Study](./projects/taxi-dw/taxi_index.qmd)
